# Idea Evaluation

## Purpose

Evaluate and rank a supplied candidate set against evidence and acceptance criteria.

## Preconditions

Use an explicitly approved ideation workflow with supplied candidates and declared evaluation criteria.

## Inputs

Use candidate hypotheses or directions, evidence and context, acceptance criteria, constraints, and supplied checks.

## Procedure

Apply one stated comparison rubric, assess strengths, risks, and testability, identify dominated or incomparable candidates, and recommend a root-reviewed ordering and validation plan.

## Outputs

Return exactly one strict Result with transparent evaluation plus one pending Proposal recommending candidate status or follow-up without applying it.

## Checks and Stop Conditions

Stop on missing candidates, rubric, or evidence, hidden scope changes, unsupported numeric precision, or a need for new experiments or network data.

## Authority Boundaries

Do not make the final canonical choice, mutate lifecycle state, launch experiments or Dispatches, chain capabilities, apply Proposals, or expand scope.
